# Storefire — full content for LLMs and agents

> Last updated: 2026-08-23. Source of truth: https://storefire.online (marketing) and https://github.com/the-junglist/storefire (source code). Live demo: https://shop.storefire.online

## One-line summary

StoreFire gives a WooCommerce shop a lighter, faster storefront without throwing away the WooCommerce shop behind it.

## The problem

WooCommerce stores collect themes, plugins, page builders, scripts, styles and other stuff over time. It all ends up travelling to the customer's browser on every visit. The shop isn't broken — it's carrying too much baggage.

## The explanation

StoreFire doesn't replace the WooCommerce shop. WooCommerce keeps handling the shop (products, orders, customers, payments, inventory). StoreFire handles the storefront customers actually see:

```
YOUR WOOCOMMERCE SHOP
Products · Orders · Customers · Payments · Inventory
        │
        ▼
STOREFIRE — fast storefront
        │
        ▼
CUSTOMER
```

## Three core benefits

1. **Less baggage** — keep the WooCommerce backend without making the browser carry the whole thing.
2. **Faster storefront** — a cleaner frontend with less unnecessary work happening in the browser.
3. **Keep what you've built** — products, orders and the WooCommerce setup don't need to be thrown away just because the storefront needs improving.

## You don't need to rebuild your shop

If WooCommerce already does the job, why replace it? StoreFire separates the storefront from the baggage instead of starting the business again from scratch.

Old way:
WooCommerce + Theme + Plugins + Page builder + Scripts + Everything else → Customer

StoreFire way:
WooCommerce → StoreFire → Customer

## Under the bonnet (verified technical facts)

StoreFire uses WooCommerce for the commerce side and a separate frontend for the customer-facing side. Products, prices, carts and orders still connect to the WooCommerce system; the storefront doesn't have to be WordPress rendering every part of the shopping experience.

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Frontend | Nuxt 4 + Vue 3 |
| Commerce | WooCommerce REST API |
| Cart & checkout | CoCart — session-based, no login needed |
| Caching | Nitro cache — Cloudflare KV in production |
| Images | Nuxt Image — avif/webp, responsive |
| Hosting | Cloudflare Pages |

The commerce backend is pluggable: Odoo is supported alongside WooCommerce via a single configuration switch. Source code: https://github.com/the-junglist/storefire

## Pricing

- **Self-hosted**: £0. Open source software — deploy it yourself.
- **Managed hosting**: no monthly fee and no fixed subscription. A small share of each sale, agreed up front. No sale, no fee.

No invented performance numbers appear anywhere in Storefire marketing: specific speed percentages, conversion claims or SEO guarantees are deliberately not made.

## FAQ

### What is StoreFire?
A lighter storefront that sits in front of your existing WooCommerce shop. Customers get a faster site to browse; WooCommerce keeps running the shop behind it.

### Does StoreFire replace WooCommerce?
No. WooCommerce keeps handling products, orders, customers and payments. Only the part shoppers see changes.

### Do I need to rebuild my shop?
No. Your WooCommerce setup stays exactly as it is. StoreFire connects to it — you don't start from scratch.

### What happens to my products and orders?
Nothing. They stay in WooCommerce, right where they are.

### Is StoreFire for developers?
You can run it yourself if you're comfortable deploying a web app — it's open source. Or talk to the team about running it for you.

### Can I use it with my existing WooCommerce store?
Yes — that's what it's built for. If a shop runs WooCommerce today, StoreFire can front it.
